sample_unit: screening mammography cases (179 cancer, 361 normal) read by 17 radiologists and 26 trainees

links.outcome: Standalone AI performance versus radiologists and trainees; no human-with-AI arm
links.effect: AI case-level AUC 0.974 vs radiologists 0.82±0.06 (P=0.01) and trainees 0.74±0.05 (P<0.0001). Lesion sensitivity 66.3% AI, 67.0% radiologists, 55.0% trainees. Human-AI team performance not assessed.
links.quote: AI achieved higher case-level AUC (0.974) than radiologists (0.82±0.06;P=0.01) and trainees (0.74±0.05;P<0.0001) across breast densities.

screen.reason: The study compares an AI model's case- and lesion-level diagnostic performance on mammography test sets against radiologists and radiology trainees, providing empirical evaluation of AI strengths and limitations.
